INFO revision=0x260, READ serial fixture=101112131415161718, SHA-256 digest fixture and GEN_KEY public-key fixture all equal the QOM fixtures; randint returns a deterministic value inside the requested range. 0156 also fixes the response CRC to the frozen driver's exact _at_crc algorithm, READ/SHA/NONCE/GEN_KEY response modes, and exposes serial/wake/idle/read QOM fixtures. All values are fixed non-secret test vectors; real ECDSA/AES-GCM/Trust&GO certificate chains, key-slot locking/permissions, the 10Kb EEPROM and production key material are NOT RUN/absent.
